IC1: Histologically confirmed PD-L1 status defined NSCLC. Biopsy must be within 70 days of first treatment with pembrolizumab.
IC4: Uni-dimensionally measurable disease [AND] according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST) v1.1
IC5: Computerised Tomography (CT) scan of chest and abdomen within 28 days of starting pembrolizumab.
IC11: Serum bilirubin ≤1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN).
IC13: Adequate renal function: Creatinine clearance <1.5 times ULN concurrent with creatinine clearance >50 ml/min.
IC14: Provision of signed and dated, written informed consent prior to any study specific procedures, sampling and analyses.
